en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
New Content:

[+] Added the Magicule Stove, new foods, and other items. Foods made with these items will provide EP bonuses. Foods with EP bonuses can still be crafted without obtaining the Cook skill, but their effects will be weaker.
[+] Added the Ultimate Skill “Uriel”.
[+] Added three new types of crystals, including Wisdom Crystals and Gluttony Crystals. Swallowing 10 of them unlocks permission to “lock” the corresponding Ultimate Skill.
[+] Added a new feature for players with the “Raphael” skill: the Stomach can now configure a block blacklist to prevent specific blocks from being swallowed.
[+] Added more race reputation-related race quests.
[+] Added a new support skill, “Human Form”. It is obtained after becoming a True Demon Lord or True Hero, and changes the player to Steve’s normal size regardless of their current body size.
[+] Added a model for the player Slime race. After swallowing an Otherworlder or player, the player will automatically and permanently transform into Steve form.
[+] Added an “Enable Rimuru Mode” option to the race selection screen. This can only be selected during the first race selection, and is disabled by default in the server configuration.
Adjustments & Optimizations:
[+] Adjusted the Unicorn spawn rate, greatly increasing its spawn rate in Flower Forests.
[+] Improved the gameplay experience: low-tier Magic Beast Hide can now be crafted into higher-tier Magic Beast Hide.
[+] Optimized the race selection screen with new character art and other content. Some races now also have unique models.
[+] Standardized the quest book and added some new content.
Compatibility & Integrations:
[+] Made compatibility adjustments to prevent some mods from causing the main menu to appear transparent.
[+] Added Jade integration, allowing players to directly view the skills owned by creatures, up to 15 skills.
Fixes:
[+] Fully fixed the issue where Boss animations could get stuck.
[+] Fixed an issue where SHP for cultivation races was always 60.
[+] Fixed an issue where reset counter quests were not syncing properly.
[+] Fixed an issue where foods with the same EP attributes could not stack.
Please download the modpack from the official website or Quark Drive.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
新增内容：
[+] 新增魔素灶台、新食物等物品。制作出的食物将带有 EP 加成；即使未获得 Cook 技能，也可以制作带有 EP 加成的食物，但效果相对较弱。
[+] 新增究极技能「乌列尔」。
[+] 新增智慧结晶、暴食结晶等三种结晶，吞噬 10 个后可解锁“锁定”对应究极技能的权限。
[+] 为拥有「拉斐尔」技能的玩家新增功能：胃袋可配置黑名单方块，防止吞噬指定方块。
[+] 添加更多种族声望相关的种族任务。
[+] 新增辅助技能「人形状态」：成为真魔王或真勇者后获取，无论当前体型如何，都会变为史蒂夫正常大小。
[+] 新增玩家史莱姆种族建模；吞噬异世界人或玩家后，将自动永久变为史蒂夫形态。
[+] 种族界面新增“是否开启利姆露模式”选项，仅首次选择种族时可选，服务器默认配置为关闭。
调整与优化：
[+] 调整独角兽刷新率，大幅提高其在繁花森林中的刷新率。
[+] 优化游玩体验：现在可以将手头的低级魔物皮合成为高级魔物皮。
[+] 优化种族选择界面，新增立绘等内容，部分种族现在拥有独立模型。
[+] 任务书进行规范性修改，并增加部分新内容。
兼容与联动：
[+] 进行兼容性调整，防止部分模组导致主界面显示透明的问题。
[+] 联动 Jade，现在可以直接查看生物拥有的技能，最多显示 15 个。
修复内容：
[+] 完全修复 Boss 动画卡住的问题。
[+] 修复修仙种族中 SHP 始终为 60 的问题。
[+] 修复重置计数器任务不同步的问题。
[+] 修复拥有相同 EP 属性的食物无法堆叠的问题。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
